ev.q: survive combat against waves of enemies in 30 minute runs
Halls of Torment is a fantasy role-playing game (RPG)
Characters are controlled from an isometric perspective in a pre-rendered, hellish environment
grainy character sprites, low fidelity voice-overs
Experience points can be invested into stats such as health, regen, attack speed
Before starting a run, players can select from a roster of 11 characters
a chest that offers the choice between three different pieces of armor or jewelry
